source.title: Weakly Picard operators: equivalent definitions, applications and open problems

accepted.question_text: Let X be a nonempty set and let A:X->X be an operator. Write A^0 for the identity on X and A^{n+1}=A composed with A^n, and write F_A={x in X: A(x)=x} for the fixed point set. Suppose there is a point x* in X such that F_A=F_{A^n}={x*} for every n>=1. Construct a K-metric d:X x X->K on X, meaning a K-valued distance with d(x,y)=0 iff x=y, d(x,y)=d(y,x), and d(x,z)<=d(x,y)+d(y,z), such that A becomes a contraction on (X,d). In the K-metric contraction formulation used in the same setting, this can be targeted by finding a positive linear operator Q:K->K with ||Q||<1 and d(Ax,Ay)<=Q(d(x,y)) for all x,y in X.
accepted.context_brief: Converse fixed point principle for a unique periodic fixed point

evidence.quote: FA = FAn = {x∗ }, for each n ∈ N∗ . Construct a K-metric d on X such that A : (X, d) → (X, d) is a contraction.

needs_review.question_text_raw: Open question 1 asks to use earlier equivalent statements from the paper to study sequences of iterates of an operator.
Open question 2B asks for a K-metric under the condition F_A=F_{A^n} nonempty for every positive n, with orbital continuity and an S-inequality for d(A^2(x),A(x)).

Open question 2C asks, for a compact K-metric space (X,d) and continuous A with intersection of all A^n(X) equal to {x*}, to construct a K-metric rho topologically equivalent to d and satisfying the printed contraction condition.

Open question 2D asks, for a compact K-metric space (X,d) and continuous A with intersection of all A^n(X) equal to F_A, to construct a K-metric rho topologically equivalent to d and satisfying the printed S-inequality condition.

trace.notes: Normalized the single input URL https://zbmath.org/5077495 as a zbMATH resolver record.

The zbMATH REST API record identified document 5077495 as the 2006 Fixed Point Theory article by Rus, Petrusel, and Serban. The record provided title and journal metadata but no full-text links, so extraction was not performed from zbMATH metadata.

Exact-title recovery found the journal PDF at https://www.math.ubbcluj.ro/~nodeacj/download.php?f=061rus.pdf. The PDF title page matched the zbMATH title and source pages 3-22, so this PDF was accepted as the primary full-text artifact and downloaded locally.

Mapped the PDF section hierarchy: Introduction; K-metrics generated by K-functionals; Schroder's pair; Caristi operators on K-metric spaces; Invariant subsets; Some suggestive results; Picard operators; Weakly Picard operators; Weakly Picard operators on compact metric spaces; Sequences of iterates and fixed points; Converses of the fixed point principles in K-metric spaces. Likely open-question regions are Section 10 and Section 11.
